description: This Swift extension provides helper functions for the CronSettings class, including accessing selected job, formatting status colors, summarizing schedules, formatting durations, and generating labels for next run times.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: A class managing cron job settings associated with the store.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Computed property that retrieves the currently selected CronJob based on the store’s selectedJobId.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Returns a Color representing the status, such as green for 'ok', red for 'error', orange for 'skipped', or secondary color otherwise.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string summary of a given CronSchedule, handling different schedule types.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Returns a concise duration string for a given duration in milliseconds using DurationFormattingSupport.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Returns a label indicating when the next scheduled run is relative to now.
